$comment: Deck slides at 1920 by 1080. Each type is drawn on one of the share-image layouts (brand/assets/image.json, src/assets/og.ts) at slide size, so a deck carries the same lockup, label chips, red full stop, room, stacks and footer as the posts: cover is the homepage layout, section the red room, statement the brief, bullets the brief with a list of red-marked points, stat the big number, quote the hollow wordmark layout, image the feature window, end the red room with the full lockup. A slide draws only the copy it is given; `sample` is the playground's sample copy, drawn with --sample.

cover.name: Cover
cover.description: The homepage layout: the lockup, the title centered with its red stop, a red label, a line under it and the address.

sample.title: Everything your agent needs to know.
sample.body: Conare finds the right answer in any data you bring, for your agents and the products you build on them.

section.name: Section
section.description: A divider on the red room: the mark, the section number in a label and the title, stacks at the sides.

agenda.name: Agenda
agenda.description: The title and up to eight numbered points in the display face, a hairline between them.

sample.title: Today.
sample.items: Where retrieval breaks | What Conare does | A live search | Questions

statement.name: Statement
statement.description: One sentence set left, the lockup top left, an optional red-marked line top right, the footer.

sample.title: Every answer comes back with its source.

bullets.name: Bullets
bullets.description: A title and up to six points, each marked with the brand's small red square.

sample.title: What your agent can do.
sample.items: Search across every document you connect | Parse scanned PDFs, tables and slides | Rerank passages before they reach the model | Return each answer with its source

stat.name: Stat
stat.description: A big number on the red room with a line under it, the mark at the top, stacks at the sides.

sample.title: Documents searched, each one returned with its source.

chart.name: Chart
chart.description: Bars from data ("label number | ..."): the brand has no chart style, so bars are its hairline grey with the largest in the accent, labels and values in mono.

timeline.name: Timeline
timeline.description: Two to six points along a hairline, each marked with the red square: "when: what".

comparison.name: Comparison
comparison.description: Two columns under a title, each a heading and up to six points, split by a hairline; the right column is marked in red.

quote.name: Quote
quote.description: A quote set large over the hollow wordmark, the attribution in a red-marked line above it.

sample.quote: Search should return the passage, not the folder.

image.name: Image
image.description: A title, a label and a line, and your picture in the product window (a wordless stand-in scene without one).

sample.title: Reranking on every query.
sample.body: Passages are ordered by relevance before they reach your agent.

grid.name: Image grid
grid.description: One to four of your pictures, each shown whole in a hairline frame ("images": [...] in the deck file).

team.name: Team
team.description: Up to eight people as name and role in hairline cards ("Name, role | ..."); no photos.

qa.name: Questions
qa.description: A closing slide for questions on the red room: your title and a line (an address or a name to write to).

end.name: End
end.description: The end card: the full lockup on the red room, a line and the address.

sample.title: Everything your agent needs to know.
